months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(옛 표본 1886~1917년 등과 2024년 11~12월 경남 산청 관찰). 번식지에서는 5월 하순~6월 하순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라에서는 1917년에 한 마리가 잡힌 뒤로 자취를 감춘 새이다. 산골 시내나 호수, 댐 둘레에 살며, 물가 나뭇가지에 앉아 물속 물고기를 노린다. 산란기는 5월 하순~6월 하순이고 한배에 알을 4~7개 낳는다. 일본, 인도, 중국 남부, 동남아시아에 분포한다.

sexes.male: 가슴의 짙은 띠에 적갈색 깃이 섞이고, 날개 아랫면 덮깃과 겨드랑이깃이 희다.
sexes.female: 가슴 띠에 적갈색이 없고, 날개 아랫면 덮깃과 겨드랑이깃이 주황빛 갈색이다.

art.subject: Crested Kingfisher (Megaceryle lugubris), adult male: large shaggy crest and crown blackish, densely spotted white; a broad dark band through the eye, a small white spot in front of the eye and a broad white stripe from the gape below the eye to the side of the neck; a dark, white-speckled moustachial stripe; white throat. Upperparts, wings and tail slaty black, finely and evenly barred and spotted white. Underparts white, with a broad breast band of dark grey spots mixed with rufous-orange, and grey bars on the flanks. Long, heavy, dagger-shaped black bill; dark eye; tiny short legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch over a mountain stream, watching the water for fish
art.scene: Korean mountain stream with clear pools and overhanging branches; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched upright on a branch: shaggy white-spotted black crest, slaty black upperparts finely barred white, white underparts with a spotted grey-and-rufous breast band, long black dagger bill

adult, head detail: white-spotted black crest and crown, broad black band through the eye with a white spot in front and a broad white stripe below, dark speckled moustachial stripe, white throat, black bill
art.build: Very large kingfisher, 37.5cm, about the size of a feral pigeon and many times bulkier than the Common Kingfisher; big-headed, with a heavy, untidy crest sticking up and back from the crown. Bill long, straight and dagger-pointed, thick at the base, roughly as long as the head. Legs extremely short, feet tiny. Body stout; tail fairly long, square-ended, barred black and white. Sits upright on a branch or rock above the water. In flight the wings look broad and barred black and white above; males show white underwing coverts, females orange-buff ones.
avoid: Do not use any blue, green or orange-chestnut kingfisher colours; the plumage is black, slate and white with only a little rufous on the male's breast.
Do not paint a smooth, neat crest or a plain unspotted black cap; the crest is large, ragged and spotted white.
Do not copy the Pied Kingfisher (Ceryle rudis), which is much smaller with a white supercilium and clean black breast bands.
Do not paint a red or yellow bill; it is black.
